snippet.title: Kingdom of Night - Release Date Trailer | PC
snippet.description:
A brand-new release date trailer for 80's-inspired action RPG, Kingdom of Night, has dropped, showcasing a flood of never-before-seen gameplay, from infernal boss battles and neon-lit streets, to haunting glimpses of the cult-driven chaos overtaking Miami, Arizona. The trailer also features an original theme song composed by none other than Vince DiCola, the legendary 1980s composer behind Transformers: The Movie and Rocky IV.

Kingdom of Night on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1094600/Kingdom_of_Night/

Set in an alternate 1987 in the quiet desert town of Miami, Arizona, Kingdom of Night follows John, a teenager who wakes to find his neighbor kidnapped by a satanic cult that has inadvertently unleashed the ancient evil Baphomet upon his hometown, turning it into a hellish invasion.

What begins as a desperate rescue mission quickly escalates into a cosmic battle for survival, as John must fight nightmarish demons, corrupted townsfolk, and high school bullies turned monstrous. Over the course of a single, harrowing night, he must infiltrate the lairs of powerful demon generals and rally the strength to confront Baphomet’s looming fortress, discovering that the fate of his friends, and perhaps the entire world, hangs in the balance.

A demo for Kingdom of Night is currently available on Steam, offering a full vertical slice of the coming-of-age adventure.

Title: Kingdom of Night
Developer: Friends of Safety
Publisher: DANGEN Entertainment
Genre: Action RPG
Players: 1
Platform: PC (Consoles TBA)
Price: $19.99 USD
Release Date: December 2, 2025
Languages: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese
